scope: Private ordinary FieldLog iOS assignment notification routing for Mixer plan §21.2.

source.pinObservation: The original app has project navigation and a new-task editor. It has no iOS assignment notification delegate or destination.

host.result: Test run with 43 tests in 1 suite passed after 0.070 seconds.
host.warm: Opened the exact persisted task and dismissed its route. The existing task editor retained its unsaved title and never invoked save.
host.cold: Received a tap before a workspace snapshot was available. Reopened the repository from disk and resolved the matching workspace, project, and task among same-titled tasks.
host.unavailable: Rejected a missing task, a foreign workspace, a foreign project, and an existing task paired with a different existing project.

genericIOS.dependencyResolution: Both configurations used the exported local public SDK and FieldLog package. Only the disposable build copy used a local manifest dependency.
genericIOS.localPosting: The ordinary Debug workspace shows a bell for an assigned task. Launch-argument-only UI test stores and Release omit it. The final binary check found the posting UI in Debug only.

independentReview.finding: A notification posted from a launch-argument-only UI test workspace could not cold-open that workspace.
independentReview.resolution: The local adapter is offered only in the ordinary Debug workspace.

limitations: The macOS tests exercise payload parsing, routing, storage, and editor state.
Delivery by iOS Notification Center, the warm window and editor lifecycle, cold OS launch, and APNs remain unverified.
earlierAttempts: Stopped the initial Xcode command after its retained project lockfile selected a cached package checkout. Exit 143 and absent owned process group were observed. The checkout was removed.

The first local Debug build succeeded. Its artifact assertion inspected the entry executable, which is an Xcode launcher stub in Debug. The final replay inspected the app code in FieldLog.debug.dylib.
